The supplier's unilateral decision to raise prices angered its long-term clients. (供應商片面決定漲價，激怒了長期合作的客戶。)
It took him a week to muster the courage to ask his boss for a raise. (他花了一個星期才鼓起勇氣向老闆要求加薪。)
She loathes long commutes, so she chose a smaller flat near her office. (她非常討厭長時間通勤，所以選了辦公室附近一間比較小的公寓。)

meaning: v. 看見；注視（文學用語）
example: Visitors who climb to the summit behold a view of three countries at once. (爬上山頂的遊客能一次看見三個國家的景色。)

meaning: adj. 有爭議的；好爭論的
example: Building a new airport runway remains a contentious issue for local residents. (興建新機場跑道對當地居民來說仍是極具爭議的問題。)

meaning:
adj. 有遠見的；空想的
n. 有遠見的人
example: The architect's visionary plan included rooftop gardens decades before they were popular. (這位建築師極具遠見的規劃，早在屋頂花園流行的幾十年前就納入了它。)
An investigative journalist spent two years tracing where the charity's money went. (一位調查記者花了兩年追查這個慈善機構的錢流向何處。)
The new test needs independent validation before hospitals can use it. (這項新檢測在醫院使用之前，需要經過獨立驗證。)

meaning: adj. 只用一種語言的；單語的
example: Unlike a bilingual dictionary, a monolingual dictionary explains words in the same language. (和雙語詞典不同，單語詞典用同一種語言解釋字義。)

meaning: adj. 家族的；家族遺傳的
example: Doctors asked whether there was any familial history of heart disease. (醫生詢問是否有心臟病的家族病史。)
Scientists tested the toxicity of the new pesticide on bees and fish. (科學家測試這種新農藥對蜜蜂和魚類的毒性。)

meaning: adj. 形成期的；對發展有重大影響的
example: She spent her formative years in a fishing village, which shaped her love of the sea. (她成長的關鍵時期在漁村度過，因此培養出對大海的熱愛。)
The documents revealed a covert operation to influence the election. (這些文件揭露了一項企圖影響選舉的祕密行動。)

meaning:
n. 移植（物）；嫁接；貪污；（英）辛苦工作
v. 移植；嫁接
example: Surgeons used a skin graft from his leg to repair the burn on his arm. (外科醫師取他腿部的皮膚移植，修補手臂上的燒傷。)
The free version of the app has limited functionality and shows adverts. (這個應用程式的免費版功能有限，而且會顯示廣告。)
The old brewery by the river has been turned into offices and a food market. (河邊的老啤酒廠已改建成辦公室和美食市集。)

meaning: adj. 非官方的；非正式的
example: According to unofficial figures, more than ten thousand people joined the march. (根據非官方數據，有超過一萬人參加遊行。)
Without air conditioning, the heat in the warehouse became unbearable by noon. (沒有冷氣，倉庫裡的高溫到中午就讓人受不了。)
Ageing populations bring societal challenges such as rising healthcare costs. (人口老化帶來醫療費用上升等社會挑戰。)
Check the compatibility of the printer with your laptop before you buy it. (購買前先確認印表機和你的筆電是否相容。)
After his execution, the reformer was remembered as a martyr for free speech. (這位改革者被處決後，人們把他視為捍衛言論自由的烈士。)

meaning:
n. 雜亂的東西；凌亂
v. 使凌亂；堆滿
example: Clearing the clutter from her desk helped her focus on the report. (把桌上的雜物清掉後，她更能專心寫報告。)
Drivers waited for an hour at the border checkpoint while officers searched trucks. (官員搜查卡車時，駕駛人在邊境檢查站等了一個小時。)
As a lifelong admirer of her paintings, he travelled to Paris for the exhibition. (身為她畫作一輩子的欣賞者，他特地飛到巴黎看展。)
The witness was charged with perjury after lying under oath about the accident. (這名證人在宣誓後就車禍作了假證詞，被以偽證罪起訴。)

meaning:
adv. 在上游；逆流而上
adj. 上游的；前段的
example: Salmon swim upstream to lay their eggs in the rivers where they were born. (鮭魚逆流而上，回到出生的河流產卵。)

meaning: n. 調色盤；（作品使用的）色調
example: The designer chose a calm palette of greys and greens for the clinic. (設計師為診所選了以灰色和綠色為主的沉穩色調。)

meaning: n. （飲食、治療的）養生法；療程
example: The doctor put him on a strict regimen of medicine, diet and daily walks. (醫生要他嚴格遵守服藥、飲食和每天散步的療程。)

meaning:
adj. 法西斯主義的
n. 法西斯主義者
example: The museum explains how fascist parties gained power in Europe in the 1920s. (博物館介紹 1920 年代法西斯政黨如何在歐洲取得政權。)

meaning:
n. 軍團；大批（人）
adj. 眾多的
example: The singer's new album was praised by her legion of loyal fans. (這位歌手的新專輯獲得大批忠實歌迷的讚賞。)
The legal system rests on the presumption that a person is innocent until proven guilty. (司法制度建立在「未經證明有罪前推定無罪」的原則上。)
The driver survived a horrific crash that destroyed three cars on the motorway. (這名駕駛在高速公路一場撞毀三輛車的可怕車禍中倖存。)

meaning: n. 星座；（相關事物的）一群
example: Ancient sailors used the position of each constellation to find their way at night. (古代水手利用各個星座的位置在夜裡辨認方向。)

meaning: n. 新創公司；（機器）啟動
example: He left a stable job at a bank to join a small startup that makes farm robots. (他辭去銀行的穩定工作，加入一家製造農業機器人的小型新創公司。)
The officer was dismissed for serious misconduct after taking money from a suspect. (這名警員收受嫌犯金錢，因嚴重不當行為遭到免職。)
Years of sectarian violence divided the city into separate neighbourhoods. (多年的宗派暴力把這座城市分裂成彼此隔絕的街區。)
After the data leak, the manager became paranoid about every email attachment. (資料外洩之後，經理對每一個電子郵件附件都疑神疑鬼。)

meaning: v. 實現；成為事實；突然出現
example: The promised pay rise never materialized, so several staff left the company. (承諾的加薪始終沒有兌現，於是好幾位員工離開了公司。)
The new rules aim to protect patients without putting undue pressure on nurses. (新規定的目的是保護病人，同時不給護理師過度的壓力。)

meaning:
n. 傳票
v. 傳喚；以傳票要求提交
example: The committee issued a subpoena requiring the company to hand over its emails. (委員會發出傳票，要求該公司交出電子郵件。)

meaning:
n. 模仿諷刺的作品；拙劣的模仿
v. 以諧仿方式嘲弄
example: The comedy show is a parody of reality programmes about rich families. (這個喜劇節目是在諧仿那些以富豪家庭為主題的實境節目。)
Eye colour is part of the phenotype, the traits we can observe in an organism. (眼睛顏色屬於表現型，也就是生物身上可以觀察到的特徵。)

meaning: n. 安慰；使人放心的話
example: Customers wanted reassurance that their savings were safe after the bank's mistake. (銀行出錯後，客戶希望得到存款安全無虞的保證。)
Each municipality decides how often household rubbish is collected. (各市政當局自行決定家庭垃圾多久收一次。)

meaning: n. 歸因；（作品、引文的）出處標示
example: You may reuse the photo for free, but attribution to the photographer is required. (這張照片可以免費使用，但必須標示攝影師姓名。)
The city recorded fewer homicides this year than at any time in the past decade. (這座城市今年的兇殺案數量是十年來最少的。)
The old town's narrow streets and lantern-lit cafés enchant visitors every evening. (老城區狹窄的街道和點著燈籠的咖啡館，每晚都讓遊客著迷。)

meaning: adj. 影響深遠的；開創性的
example: Her seminal paper on sleep and memory is still cited by researchers today. (她那篇關於睡眠與記憶的開創性論文，至今仍被研究者引用。)

meaning: n. （美）選區；警察分局轄區；（英）（禁止車輛的）區域；（建築的）周圍地帶
example: Voters in each precinct cast their ballots at a nearby school or library. (每個選區的選民都在附近的學校或圖書館投票。)
The IT team configured the new laptops before giving them to staff. (資訊部門先設定好新筆電，再發給員工。)

meaning:
adj. 不受控制的；脫序的；不法的
n. 流氓；無賴
example: A rogue trader hid huge losses from the bank for almost two years. (一名違規交易員向銀行隱瞞巨額虧損將近兩年。)
Platinum is used in car parts that reduce harmful exhaust gases. (鉑被用在可以減少有害廢氣的汽車零件中。)

meaning:
n. 精品店
adj. 精品的；小而精緻的
example: She runs a small boutique that sells clothes made by local designers. (她經營一家販售本地設計師服飾的小精品店。)

meaning: v. 使制度化；（把人）送進收容機構
example: The company institutionalized flexible hours after the trial proved popular. (試行結果大受歡迎後，公司把彈性工時正式制度化。)
The library is often cited as an exemplar of energy-efficient design. (這座圖書館常被視為節能設計的典範。)

meaning: n. （心靈的）交流；（基督教）聖餐
example: Hikers often describe a feeling of communion with nature on long mountain trails. (登山客常說，走在漫長的山徑上會有一種與自然交融的感覺。)
The meeting was ostensibly about safety, but most of the time was spent on cutting costs. (這場會議名義上是討論安全，但大部分時間都在談削減成本。)

meaning: v. 重新塑造；徹底改造
example: After the factory closed, the town reinvented itself as a centre for arts and tourism. (工廠關閉後，這個小鎮轉型成藝術與觀光重鎮。)
Critics called the new law a negation of everything the reform movement had achieved. (批評者說這項新法完全否定了改革運動的所有成果。)

meaning: n. （想法的）清楚表達；發音；關節
example: The report praised the mission statement for its clear articulation of the charity's goals. (報告稱讚這份宗旨聲明清楚表達了慈善機構的目標。)

meaning: n. 好轉；（業績）轉虧為盈；處理所需時間
example: The new chief executive led a dramatic turnaround, and the firm made a profit within a year. (新任執行長帶動驚人的轉機，公司在一年內就轉虧為盈。)
Many families fled the country to escape religious persecution. (許多家庭為了逃離宗教迫害而離開國家。)
Most butterflies have symmetric wings, with matching patterns on each side. (大多數蝴蝶的翅膀是對稱的，兩側花紋相互對應。)
The reactivity of sodium explains why it must be stored away from water. (鈉的反應性很高，所以必須存放在遠離水的地方。)

meaning: n. 社會運動；行動主義
example: Her activism began when a highway was planned through her neighbourhood. (當一條公路計畫穿過她家附近時，她開始投入社會運動。)
The history course compares the rise of fascism in Italy and Germany. (這門歷史課比較法西斯主義在義大利和德國的崛起。)
The exhibition looks at how imperialism changed trade and farming in Southeast Asia. (這場展覽探討帝國主義如何改變東南亞的貿易與農業。)

meaning: n. 黏附；黏著力；（醫）沾黏
example: Tiny hairs on a gecko's feet give it strong adhesion to smooth walls. (壁虎腳上的細毛讓牠能牢牢附著在光滑的牆面上。)
The survey measures victimization by asking whether people have experienced crime. (這項調查透過詢問民眾是否遭遇犯罪來衡量受害情況。)

meaning: n. 罪犯；元兇；問題的根源
example: Engineers found that a cheap cable was the culprit behind the repeated power cuts. (工程師發現，一條便宜的電纜就是一再停電的元兇。)

meaning: adj. 非自願的；不自主的
example: Blinking is usually involuntary, but we can also control it when we choose. (眨眼通常是不自主的，但我們想控制時也做得到。)
Gardeners use cuttings for the propagation of plants that grow poorly from seed. (園丁用扦插來繁殖那些不易從種子長大的植物。)
He is a fitness fanatic who trains at the gym every morning before work. (他是個健身狂，每天上班前都會去健身房鍛鍊。)
Her paternal grandparents ran a small bakery in the same street for fifty years. (她的祖父母（父親那一方）在同一條街上開了五十年的小麵包店。)
Some people find spirituality in meditation and long walks rather than in religion. (有些人不是從宗教，而是從冥想和長時間散步中找到心靈寄託。)
The workshop helps teams conceptualize a product before they spend money on it. (這個工作坊協助團隊在投入資金前先構思產品概念。)

meaning:
n. 勒索；敲詐
v. 勒索；要挾
example: The hackers tried to blackmail the company by threatening to publish customer data. (駭客威脅要公開客戶資料，企圖勒索這家公司。)
The rapid mobilization of volunteers saved many homes during the flood. (志工迅速動員，在洪水期間保住了許多住家。)

meaning:
adj. 代理的；替代的
n. 代理人；替代品；代理孕母
example: For the orphaned elephants, the keepers act as surrogate mothers. (對那些失去母親的小象來說，保育員就像代理媽媽。)
The heterogeneity of the sample makes it hard to draw a single conclusion. (樣本的異質性很高，很難得出單一結論。)

meaning:
n. 逃犯；逃亡者
adj. 逃亡的；短暫的
example: The fugitive was arrested at the airport after three months on the run. (這名逃犯逃亡三個月後在機場被捕。)

meaning: n. 評分標準；（書中的）標題、說明
example: The rubric shows how many points are given for structure, grammar and ideas. (評分標準列出結構、文法和觀點各占多少分。)

meaning: n. 方式；形式；（感官的）類型
example: The course is offered in two modalities: online and in person. (這門課提供兩種上課方式：線上和實體。)

meaning:
v. 指定（款項）用於；預留
n. 特徵；標記
example: The council has earmarked half the budget for repairing roads. (議會已指定把一半預算用於修路。)

meaning: adj. 推定的；公認的；被認為的
example: Scientists are testing the putative link between the gene and hearing loss. (科學家正在檢驗該基因與聽力損失之間被推定存在的關聯。)
Police used camera footage to identify the perpetrators of the robbery. (警方利用監視器畫面找出搶案的犯人。)

meaning: n. 頻寬；（口）處理事情的餘力
example: Video calls use a lot of bandwidth, so the connection slows down when everyone is online. (視訊通話很耗頻寬，所以大家同時上線時網路就會變慢。)

meaning: n. 長篇故事；一連串事件；傳奇
example: The saga of the delayed railway line has lasted more than ten years. (這條鐵路一再延宕的風波已經拖了十多年。)

meaning: n. 懷孕期；（計畫的）醞釀期
example: Elephants have the longest gestation of any land mammal, about twenty-two months. (大象是陸地哺乳動物中懷孕期最長的，大約二十二個月。)
The manager apologised for his angry outburst during the meeting. (經理為自己在會議中突然發脾氣道歉。)

meaning: v. 聲稱；公開表示；信奉
example: He professed to know nothing about the missing money, but nobody believed him. (他聲稱對那筆不見的錢一無所知，但沒有人相信他。)

meaning:
n. 觀點；偏向；傾斜
v. 傾斜；（報導）偏頗
example: The documentary gives the history of the city a fresh slant by focusing on its workers. (這部紀錄片聚焦於這座城市的勞工，為它的歷史提供了全新的觀點。)

meaning:
n. 假釋
v. 准予假釋
example: He was released on parole after serving six years of a ten-year sentence. (他在十年刑期服完六年後獲得假釋。)

meaning:
n. （罷工的）糾察隊；尖木樁
v. 在……外設糾察線、抗議
example: Striking nurses picketed outside the hospital to demand safer staffing levels. (罷工的護理師在醫院外面拉起糾察線，要求更安全的人力配置。)

meaning:
n. 前景；最顯著的位置
v. 突顯；使成為重點
example: In the foreground of the painting, two farmers rest beside a cart. (在這幅畫的前景，兩名農夫在一輛推車旁休息。)
Advances in biotechnology have made it faster to develop new vaccines. (生物科技的進步讓新疫苗的研發速度變快。)

meaning: adj. 默示的；心照不宣的
example: There was a tacit agreement among the staff not to discuss salaries. (員工之間有一種不談薪水的默契。)
The film shows the brutality of the war through the eyes of a young soldier. (這部電影透過一名年輕士兵的眼睛呈現戰爭的殘酷。)

meaning: n. 易受影響（的程度）；感受性
example: Poor sleep increases our susceptibility to colds and other infections. (睡眠不足會讓我們更容易感冒和受到其他感染。)
A mania for tulips in the 1630s drove bulb prices to absurd levels. (1630 年代的鬱金香狂熱，把球根價格推到荒謬的高點。)
Because of budgetary limits, the library will close on Sundays from next month. (由於預算限制，圖書館從下個月起週日將不開放。)

meaning: adj. 非典型的；不尋常的
example: Such heavy rain in July is atypical for this dry region. (對這個乾燥地區來說，七月下這麼大的雨並不尋常。)
Divers recovered parts of the plane's wreckage from the bottom of the lake. (潛水員從湖底打撈出飛機的部分殘骸。)
Trucks laden with fresh vegetables arrive at the market before dawn. (滿載新鮮蔬菜的卡車在天亮前抵達市場。)
The sign on the office door says: no sales or solicitation allowed. (辦公室門上的告示寫著：禁止推銷或募捐。)

meaning: n. 操縱者；善於擺布別人的人
example: In the novel, the charming uncle turns out to be a cold manipulator. (在小說裡，那位迷人的叔叔原來是個冷酷的操縱者。)
Workers who report safety problems are protected by law from retaliation. (通報安全問題的員工受到法律保護，不會遭到報復。)
The standardization of shipping containers made global trade much cheaper. (貨櫃規格的標準化讓全球貿易成本大幅降低。)

meaning:
v. 稍微調整；擰
n. 小幅調整
example: The chef tweaked the recipe by adding less sugar and more lemon. (主廚稍微調整了食譜，少放一點糖、多加一點檸檬。)
Online advertising has become the main battleground for the two phone makers. (網路廣告已成為這兩家手機製造商的主戰場。)

meaning: adj. 不祥的；預示凶兆的
example: Dark clouds gathered over the harbour, and fishermen took the ominous sign seriously. (烏雲聚集在港口上空，漁民們把這個不祥的徵兆當一回事。)

meaning: adj. 主題的；按主題分類的
example: The museum arranges its collection in thematic rooms rather than by date. (這間博物館依主題而不是年代來安排展間。)

meaning: adj. 有韌性的；能迅速恢復的
example: Small family farms proved surprisingly resilient during the economic crisis. (經濟危機期間，小型家庭農場展現出驚人的韌性。)
Parliament voted to impeach the president for abuse of power. (國會以濫權為由表決彈劾總統。)

meaning: v. 精心策劃；編寫管弦樂曲
example: She orchestrated the merger of the two firms without a single public leak. (她精心策劃了兩家公司的合併，過程中沒有任何消息外洩。)
The climate treaty came into force after ratification by fifty-five countries. (這項氣候條約在五十五個國家批准後生效。)

meaning:
n. 諷刺漫畫；誇張的描繪
v. 以漫畫諷刺；誇張描繪
